name: Το Μονοπάτι της Εκεχειρίας
description_md:
Το Μονοπάτι της Εκεχειρίας is a waymarked hiking route in GR. This trail spans 49.7 km and requires about 15 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The route is part of the national waymarked hiking network and is classified as hard due to the distance and 791 m of ascent. It features 789 m of descent. The path passes within 500 m of Theokoleon and within 600 m of the Statue of Zeus at Olympia and Olympia.
